caption:
Ferrari has 16 Formula 1 constructors' titles. Nobody else has more than 10.

Watch Vanwall open the count in 1958, Lotus lead the way through the sixties, Ferrari take the lead in 1982 — and watch Mercedes stack eight titles from 2014.

📊 See every Formula 1 Constructors' Championship from 1958 to 2025 in this animated ranking. Explore how Ferrari, McLaren, Williams, Lotus, Mercedes and Red Bull built their totals, and when each era began and ended.

Source: F1DB — Formula One database, github.com/f1db/f1db (CC BY 4.0). Flags show each team's racing licence nationality.
